title: Lens: Troubleshooting
summary: Diagnose common Lens failures by shrinking the loop and testing one fix.

blocks.title: Common Failure
blocks.body: If Lens gives little information, check whether the owning addon is loaded and try scanning adjacent blocks in complex machines.

blocks.title: Reset The Loop
blocks.body: If Lens seems unhelpful, scan a more specific target, stand closer, compare the tooltip with Wiki or Index, and check whether the owning addon is loaded.

blocks.title: One Fix At A Time
blocks.body: Change one variable, run a smaller test, and compare the result. Fixing three things at once can hide the part that actually mattered.

blocks.title: Retest Cleanly
blocks.body: Change one variable, test on a smaller route, and keep the fix only if the failure becomes easier to explain.
